[RBND.4.5] **Forward compatibility.** A revision of the serialization
([RBND.4.2]) takes a different `magic` line, so a hash written under one
revision never equals a hash written under another. Two artefacts whose hashes
were written under different revisions therefore fail the dialect-binding check
([RBND.5.1]) with `DS_ERR_BND_DIALECT_MISMATCH` ([RBND.5.2]): there is no
version field to negotiate ([RARC.4]).

---
